question: In Slack: Invite to #incident-response whoever posted the message in #incidents about the deploy freeze that got 4 replies. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No such message found — so no invite was sent.

I checked all of #incidents: there's only one deploy-freeze message, "Update: extending the deploy freeze another week." (posted by Maya). Its thread has **3 replies** — "Reason is the pending audit." / "Will lift it once that's done." / "Thanks for your patience everyone." — all from Maya herself.

So there's no deploy-freeze message with 4 replies. If you actually meant that thread (Maya, 3 replies), say the word and I'll invite her to #incident-response.
